title: Virgo: your 2027,
month by month.
summary: You've carried everyone. Late November, luck lands on you. The five chapters of a Virgo year, what each month is for, and the dates to know.
imageAlt: Maya holding a Virgo flag, with a small maiden holding wheat beside her
inside: The year in five chapters, each with what to do and what to avoid
Work, love, money, energy and home, one by one
All twelve months, with your best months marked
The dates that matter, and why the year reads this way
intro: If you are a Virgo by Moon sign, 2027 is a year of carrying and then receiving. For most of it the planet of patience sits in your house of partners, the people you are closest to and the promises you keep with them. The tradition reads that as a year of effort for others, and of building relationships that last.

The planet of luck has a two part year with you. From late January to late June it sits in your house of gains and friends, read as your best stretch for help and wins. From late June it slips back into your house of rest, a quieter time to recharge. Then on November 26 it lands on your own sign, read as the year's big gift: a fresh start that is about you.

chapters.name: Catching your breath
chapters.text: The year opens with luck in your house of rest, where it has been since late October 2026, and the planet of patience in your house of partners. It is a soft, inward start. Sleep, quiet time, private plans and letting go of what you no longer need all come easily. The people closest to you still ask for steady care.
chapters.do: Rest properly, clear old clutter, and write down what you want this year to give you.
chapters.avoid: Saying yes to every request just because someone asked first.

chapters.name: Friends, help and wins
chapters.text: Luck moves into your house of gains, friends and wishes. The tradition reads this as your best stretch of the year for support from other people, for networks, and for wishes that have waited a long time. Close relationships still ask for honesty and work, but now there is help around you.
chapters.do: Ask for help, join the group, and go after the goal you have been quietly wishing for.
chapters.avoid: Doing everything alone out of habit when people are offering a hand.

chapters.name: Partners ease, the inner work begins
chapters.text: The planet of patience steps out of your house of partners and into your house of deep change: shared money, research, hidden matters and inner change. Relationships ask a little less of you, and your attention turns inward. Luck is still in your house of gains for these three weeks, so it is a good bridge between a busy spring and a quieter summer.
chapters.do: Tidy up one shared or joint matter and finish what the spring started.
chapters.avoid: Reading a quieter, more private mood as a bad sign. It is read as depth.

chapters.name: A quiet spell
chapters.text: Luck slips back into your house of rest, retreat and far places, read as a time to recharge, travel far and let go. Until October 18 the planet of patience is in your house of deep change, a quiet spell of inner work. From October 19 it returns to your house of partners, so the people closest to you come back into focus.
chapters.do: Plan real rest, a retreat or a long trip, and protect your quiet time.
chapters.avoid: Filling every free evening. The tradition reads this stretch as a recharge before your turn.

chapters.name: Luck lands on you
chapters.text: Luck moves onto your own sign. The tradition reads this as one of the best signs a year can bring: more confidence, more energy and a fresh start that is about you, after a long time of looking after others. You meet it with relationships you have spent the year making stronger.
chapters.do: Start the thing that is just for you, and let people see what you can do.
chapters.avoid: Giving the new energy away to everyone else before you have used it yourself.

allYear: All year a hungry influence sits in your house of joy, romance and creative work, read as sudden crushes and a big appetite to create. Its calm partner sits in your house of gains, read as a choosier, quieter side to friendship.

areas.name: Work and career
areas.text: The first half is the strongest for help from colleagues, networks and people who can open doors. The second half is quieter and better for planning and private work. Late November brings a fresh start and new confidence in what you do.

areas.name: Love and relationships
areas.text: Most of the year the planet of patience sits in your house of partners, read as tests, talks and commitments that are built to last. June to October gives that house a rest. Romance is lively all year, with sudden sparks, so go slowly.

areas.name: Money
areas.text: Late January to late June is read as the best stretch for gains and for things coming back to you. June to October brings shared money and joint matters into focus. This is a reading of the sky, not financial advice: keep joint matters clear and in writing.

areas.name: Energy and wellbeing
areas.text: Carrying others is tiring, and the tradition reads the long stay in your house of partners as a year of effort. Late June to late November is your recharge window: rest on purpose, so you are ready for your turn.

areas.name: Home and family
areas.text: Home is steady this year. The people you love most ask for your time, especially from January to May and again from late October. A calm routine at home keeps you from feeling stretched too thin.

areas.name: Travel and learning
areas.text: Late June to late November favours long journeys, retreats and quiet study, the kind of learning you do on your own. January also has this mood. It is the part of the year to go somewhere far and come back lighter.

months.text: A soft start. Rest, clear old clutter and keep your plans private until the 23rd. From the 24th luck moves into your house of friends and gains, and help starts to arrive.
Friends, groups and helpful people are on your side. Ask for support with something you usually carry alone. Close relationships still need honest talks.
A good month to go after a long held wish. Networks, teams and introductions work in your favour. Keep your promises to the people closest to you while the wins come in.
Help and wins keep coming. Say yes to the invitation and the group project. Your partnerships are being tested and strengthened at the same time.
The last full month of your best stretch. Finish what you started with other people's help, and thank the ones who showed up. A lighter, more private summer is coming.
On the 2nd partners ease and your focus turns inward to deep change. On the 25th luck slips back into your house of rest. A month of slowing down after a busy spring.
A quiet spell. Rest, retreat and private study suit you now. Shared money and joint matters ask to be sorted out calmly. Protect your evenings.
A good month for a long trip or a real break. Let go of one habit or obligation that drains you. The inner work you do now is read as preparing you for your turn.
Keep the pace gentle. Quiet time, far places and reflection restore you more than a busy calendar. Finish one private project you care about.
Still a recharging month. On the 19th the people closest to you come back into focus, and close relationships ask for steady care again. Bring them the calm you have built.
Rest until the 25th. On the 26th luck lands on your own sign, read as the year's big gift: more confidence, more energy and a fresh start that is about you.
Your turn has begun. Start the thing that is just for you, let people see what you can do, and plan the year ahead with your own goals first.

dates.text: Luck moves into your house of gains. Your best stretch for friends, help and wins begins.
Partners ease; the focus turns to deep change and inner work until October 18.
Luck slips back into your house of rest. The quiet, recharging spell begins.
The people closest to you come back into focus for the rest of the year.
Luck lands on your own sign: the year's big gift and a fresh start.

why.name: Jupiter, the planet of luck and growth
why.text: Jupiter is in Leo, your twelfth house of rest, until January 23, as it has been since October 31, 2026. It moves into Cancer, your eleventh house of gains, from January 24 to June 24. It returns to Leo from June 25 to November 25, then enters Virgo, your own sign, on November 26.

why.name: Saturn, the planet of patience and effort
why.text: Saturn has been in Pisces, your seventh house of partners, since March 29, 2025. It stays there from January 1 to June 1 and again from October 19. From June 2 to October 18 it moves forward into Aries, your eighth house of deep change.

why.name: Rahu and Ketu, the Moon's nodes
why.text: Rahu moved into Capricorn, your fifth house of joy and romance, on December 5, 2026, and stays there all of 2027. Ketu sits opposite in Cancer, your eleventh house of gains, which adds a calmer, choosier note to friendships.

faq.q: Is this for my Sun sign or my Moon sign?
faq.a: Your Moon sign. Vedic astrology reads timing from the sign the Moon was in when you were born, which is often different from the Sun sign most people know.

faq.q: I'm a Virgo Sun. Does this apply to me?
faq.a: Only if your Moon is also in Virgo. Many people with a Virgo Sun have their Moon somewhere else. Your birth chart shows it in a few seconds.
They are calculated from the planets' real positions, in US Eastern time, and they are the same for everyone with this Moon sign. What they mean for you in detail depends on the rest of your chart.

note: Dates are US Eastern time. Vedic (sidereal) astrology, read by Moon sign.
